briefing: Markets were neutral-to-slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.7%, S&P 500 -0.4%) with no clear risk-on signal. Per prior lessons, we're holding our current 7 positions and keeping cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy into a flat market.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors pull back from riskier assets and avoid new positions until conditions look more favorable, even if the market isn't crashing. Today's neutral, slightly negative tone doesn't offer the multi-signal confirmation (like a strong NASDAQ rally) needed to justify deploying new cash, so staying patient and holding cash is the disciplined move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「Risk-Off」是指投資者在市況不明朗時減少承險，暫緩新增持倉，即使市場並非急跌。今日大市走勢中性偏弱，缺乏足夠的多重訊號確認（例如納指強勢反彈）去支持動用現金買入，因此保持耐性、持有現金是較穩健的做法。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted lower today with no single dominant catalyst, reflecting a pause after recent moves rather than a sharp risk-off event. Trading volume and sector breadth were mixed, suggesting investors are waiting for clearer signals before committing new capital. No specific news headlines were available in today's feed to pinpoint the exact driver.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍走弱，未見單一主導因素，反映市場在近期波動後進入喘息階段，而非明顯的risk-off情況。成交量及板塊表現參差，顯示投資者在加碼前仍在等待更明確的訊號。今日資訊中未提供具體新聞標題以確定確切原因。
